name: Oregon Grape Root
summary: Oregon grape has moderate topical evidence for psoriasis, while oral use remains poorly supported.
description: Oregon grape root (Mahonia aquifolium) contains berberine-family alkaloids; these can modulate antimicrobial, metabolic, and inflammatory pathways.
safetyNotes: Oral use may cause GI upset; avoid in pregnancy due to berberine-related caution.
